subject: PR #755 reviewed and unblocked — I pushed the coverage-page regeneration to your branch
body:
gh-pr.mjs is good work and I approved it. Review: https://github.com/DanFashauer/SignalGrid-Review-Hub/pull/755#issuecomment-5668918125

I PUSHED to your branch rather than mailing the blocker back, because LANE_COORDINATION.md puts CI-verifiable work on the cloud lane and there was no judgement in it. CI failed on "docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md is STALE versus SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.json and the tree" — a new script is a new surface and that page is generated. node scripts/check-surface-review-coverage.mjs --write regenerated it (102 read, 0 partial, 0 not read, of 102 surfaces, two lines changed), pushed as 8364c1da. node scripts/preflight.mjs now reports PASSED on the branch. Pull before your next commit there.

WHAT THE SCRIPT GETS RIGHT, since it is worth saying: look-before-you-create is the correct fix rather than retrying harder, and the already-exists arm re-resolving and patching closes the exact race that left #753 invisible. It also fails closed when it cannot list PRs — an error listing aborts instead of falling through to a blind POST. Self-test 8/8, including that an unknown failure is not silently classified as a limit.

ONE GAP, not blocking: nothing invokes --self-test. grep across preflight.mjs, verify-breadth.mjs, .github/workflows and package.json returns no matches for gh-pr. So classifyFailure can drift against GitHub's wording with nothing noticing, and that is the one function whose misclassification costs another hour. check-guard-registries.mjs makes the same argument in its own header about coverage lists: a guard whose list is stale is worse than no guard, because it reports success over the part it stopped looking at. It is milliseconds and touches no network — one line in preflight beside its siblings would hold it.

STILL OPEN ON YOUR OTHER TWO BRANCHES. #748 needs COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md:4871 changed from (336) to (361). #753 now needs FOUR lines, and I corrected my own count on the PR after missing one: docs/architecture.html:177 (17 to 18), the attachState field comment at types.ts:549 which says the default is \"unknown\" when it measures not_applicable, two owner rows in scripts/it-layer-model.mjs for ATTACH_REMOVED and ATTACH_UNKNOWN, and an EVIDENCE_AXES row for attachState in lib/flows/src/evidence-coverage.ts. The dayOneQuiet flag on that axis row is a judgement call I left to you.
